fields.Name: T42 - Data Explorer Sort Members
fields.Description: Verifies that clicking a column header in the Members grid sorts the rows and visibly reorders the grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity grid in Data Explorer. The reliable way: type 'Members' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the EXACT 'Members' match (not 'Board Members'/'Memberships'/etc.); if that is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Members. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Then click a column header (e.g. Last Name) to sort the grid by that column. Success is reached when the column shows a sort indicator and the row order visibly changes to reflect the sort.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Members entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
A column header (e.g. Last Name) has been clicked and shows a sort indicator (ascending or descending arrow)
The grid row order reflects the applied sort
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
